00000|Installing dependencies from lock file (including require-dev)
00001|Verifying lock file contents can be installed on current platform.
00002|Warning: The lock file is not up to date with the latest changes in composer.json. You may be getting outdated dependencies. It is recommended that you run `composer update` or `composer update <package name>`.
00003|- Required package "vendor/definitely-missing-package" is not present in the lock file.
00004|This usually happens when composer files are incorrectly merged or the composer.json file is manually edited.
00005|Read more about correctly resolving merge conflicts https://getcomposer.org/doc/articles/resolving-merge-conflicts.md
00006|and prefer using the "require" command over editing the composer.json file directly https://getcomposer.org/doc/03-cli.md#require-r
